.pad-sample{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(150px,.42fr) auto;grid-template-areas:"slot wave meta act" "slot edit edit act";min-height:74px;margin-top:7px;border:1px solid #1d241b;background:#090b09}
.ps-slot{grid-area:slot;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;border-right:1px solid #242b22}
.ps-slot span{font:700 6px var(--r3-mono);color:#5d6659;letter-spacing:.12em}
.ps-slot strong{font:800 10px var(--r3-mono);color:#e0e5dd;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ps-slot small{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font:600 6px var(--r3-mono);color:#6a7465;letter-spacing:.08em}
.ps-slot small i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#3a4236;flex:none}
.pad-sample.loaded .ps-slot small{color:#7fd9cb}
.pad-sample.loaded .ps-slot small i{background:var(--r3-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(32,215,194,.6)}
.ps-wave{grid-area:wave;position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:54px;margin:8px;border:1px solid #171d17;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(#060806,#040504);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.ps-wave canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.ps-empty{position:absolute;inset:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;border:1px dashed #283024;border-radius:2px;pointer-events:none;transition:border-color .12s}
.ps-empty .ic{width:15px;height:15px;color:#6f7a68;transition:color .12s}
.ps-empty b{display:block;font:700 7px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8a9486}
.ps-empty small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font:600 6px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:#4d554b}
.ps-wave:hover .ps-empty{border-color:#3d4a2a}
.ps-wave:hover .ps-empty .ic{color:var(--r3-accent)}
.loaded .ps-empty{display:none}
.ps-meta{grid-area:meta;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:8px 10px;border-left:1px solid #171d17}
.ps-meta .metric-line b{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.pad-sample.loaded .ps-meta .metric-line b{color:#c4ccbf}
.ps-actions{grid-area:act;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:1px solid #171d17}
.ps-btn{height:24px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #252b23;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#151915,#0d100d);color:#7a8475;font:800 7.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .12s,color .12s,background .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.ps-btn .ic{width:11px;height:11px}
.ps-btn:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--r3-accent);border-color:#55672d}
.ps-btn.primary{background:#171b0c;border-color:#4b5b17;color:var(--r3-accent)}
.ps-btn.primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#1d2410;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(200,255,0,.12)}
.ps-btn:disabled,.psm-btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.ps-btn:active:not(:disabled),.psm-btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}
.ps-btn:focus-visible,.psm-btn:focus-visible,.ps-wave:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--r3-focus)}
.ps-btn[aria-busy="true"],.psm-btn[aria-busy="true"]{pointer-events:none;color:var(--r3-warn);border-color:#5a4412}
.ps-drop{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;display:none;place-items:center;border:1px dashed var(--r3-accent);border-radius:inherit;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(200,255,0,.13),rgba(9,11,9,.94) 72%);font:700 7.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--r3-accent);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(200,255,0,.55);pointer-events:none}
.ps-drop b{color:#f2f5f0}
.drop-live>.ps-drop{display:grid}

/* pads carrying a user sample */
.pad-smp{position:absolute;right:20px;top:4px;display:none;padding:1px 3px;border:1px solid rgba(32,215,194,.45);border-radius:2px;background:rgba(32,215,194,.07);color:var(--r3-cyan);font:700 5.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.2}
.drum-pad.has-sample .pad-smp{display:block}
.drum-pad.has-sample:not(.selected):not(.hit) .pad-wave i{background:linear-gradient(#3fe6d1,#12594f)}
.drum-pad.has-sample .pad-sub{color:#5fb3a6;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.drum-pad.drop-over{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1b2410,#0b1009);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--r3-accent),inset 0 0 26px rgba(200,255,0,.14)}
.drum-pad.drop-over .pad-name{color:var(--r3-accent)}

/* piano sampler */
.psampler{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,.9fr) minmax(0,2.4fr) minmax(140px,.85fr) minmax(170px,.9fr);grid-template-areas:"head wave root act" "edit edit edit edit";gap:0 24px;align-items:end;margin-top:10px;padding:14px 16px 16px;border:1px solid #181b18;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(#0a0c0a,#080908)}
.psm-head{grid-area:head;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;min-width:0;align-self:center}
.psm-head .ctl-h b{color:#858f81}
.psampler.loaded .psm-head .ctl-h b{color:var(--r3-accent)}
.psm-file{font:500 9px var(--r3-mono);color:#6b726a;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.45;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
.psampler.loaded .psm-file{color:#aeb6aa}
.psm-file em{font-style:normal;color:#7fd9cb}
.psampler .ps-wave{margin:0;height:62px;border-color:#1c211b;border-radius:4px}
.psampler .ps-empty b{font-size:8.5px}
.psampler .ps-empty small{font-size:7px}
.psm-root{grid-area:root;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0;transition:opacity .12s}
.psampler:not(.loaded) .psm-root{opacity:.4}
.psm-root .ctl-h b{color:#858f81}
.psm-actions{grid-area:act;display:flex;gap:8px}
.psm-btn{flex:1;height:30px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #262a26;border-radius:var(--r);background:linear-gradient(#111311,#0b0c0b);color:#e3e7e2;font:600 10px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.03);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .12s,color .12s,background .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.psm-btn .ic{width:13px;height:13px}
.psm-btn:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#3d4a2a;color:var(--r3-accent-hi)}
.psm-btn.primary{flex:1.6;background:linear-gradient(#17210b,#0f1608);border-color:#4d6619;color:var(--r3-accent-hi);box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(184,224,44,.12),0 0 10px rgba(184,224,44,.12)}
.psm-btn.primary:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#6a8a22;box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px rgba(184,224,44,.18),0 0 14px rgba(184,224,44,.18)}
.psampler .obtn[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:1;cursor:not-allowed;color:#555c54;background:linear-gradient(#131513,#0c0d0c)}
.psampler>.ps-drop{border-radius:5px}
.piano-expanded .psampler{display:none}
.kc-src{display:none;margin-left:10px;padding:1px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(32,215,194,.4);border-radius:2px;background:rgba(32,215,194,.06);color:var(--r3-cyan);letter-spacing:.08em;vertical-align:1px}
.kc-src.on{display:inline-block}
.white-key.is-root::after{content:"ROOT";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:46px;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:1px 3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--r3-accent);color:#0a0d05;font:800 5.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(200,255,0,.45);pointer-events:none}
.black-key.is-root::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:24px;width:5px;height:5px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;background:var(--r3-accent);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--r3-accent);pointer-events:none}
/* waveform editor — trim handles, loop band, edit rows */
.wh{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:14px;margin-left:-7px;z-index:3;cursor:ew-resize;touch-action:none;outline:none}
.wh::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--r3-accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(200,255,0,.55);transition:width .08s,left .08s}
.wh i{position:absolute;top:0;left:7px;width:10px;height:11px;background:var(--r3-accent);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 55%,0 100%);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(200,255,0,.5)}
.wh-end i{left:auto;right:7px;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 55%)}
.wh-loopStart::before,.wh-loopEnd::before{background:var(--r3-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(32,215,194,.55)}
.wh-loopStart i,.wh-loopEnd i{top:auto;bottom:0;background:var(--r3-cyan);clip-path:polygon(0 45%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.wh-loopEnd i{left:auto;right:7px;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 45%,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.wh:hover::before,.editing .wh:focus::before{left:5px;width:4px}
.wh:focus-visible::before{left:5px;width:4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #070807,0 0 0 3px rgba(200,255,0,.72)}
.ps-wave.editing{cursor:ew-resize}
.ps-edit{grid-area:edit;display:none;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:0;padding:6px 10px 8px 8px;border-top:1px solid #171d17}
.pad-sample.loaded .ps-edit{display:flex}
.ps-ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:110px}
.ps-ctl span{font:700 6px var(--r3-mono);color:#60695d;letter-spacing:.1em}
.ps-ctl .dslider{flex:1;min-width:50px}
.ps-ctl b{min-width:44px;text-align:right;font:700 7px var(--r3-mono);color:#9aa398;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ps-region{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;white-space:nowrap}
.ps-region span{font:700 6px var(--r3-mono);color:#60695d;letter-spacing:.1em}
.ps-region b{font:700 7px var(--r3-mono);color:#c4ccbf;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ps-tog,.psm-tog{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .12s,color .12s,background .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.ps-tog{height:22px;padding:0 9px;border:1px solid #252b23;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#151915,#0d100d);color:#7a8475;font:800 7px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.1em}
.ps-tog i,.psm-tog i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#2a3226;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.8);flex:none}
.ps-tog:hover,.psm-tog:hover{color:var(--r3-accent);border-color:#55672d}
.ps-tog.on,.psm-tog.on{background:linear-gradient(#17210b,#0f1608);border-color:#4d6619;color:var(--r3-accent-hi)}
.ps-tog.on i,.psm-tog.on i{background:var(--r3-accent-hi);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--r3-accent)}
.psm-tog.loop.on{background:linear-gradient(#0c1d1a,#081311);border-color:#1d5f55;color:#7ff0e0}
.psm-tog.loop.on i{background:var(--r3-cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--r3-cyan)}
.ps-tog:focus-visible,.psm-tog:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--r3-focus)}
.ps-btn.ghost{height:22px;background:transparent}
.psm-edit{grid-area:edit;display:none;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #161916}
.psampler.loaded .psm-edit{display:flex}
.psm-tog{height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #262a26;border-radius:var(--r);background:linear-gradient(#111311,#0b0c0b);color:#e3e7e2;font:600 10px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.06em;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.psm-gain{flex:1;min-width:150px;max-width:280px}
.psm-gain .strack{margin:6px 0 2px}
.psm-region{flex:1;min-width:0;font:500 9px var(--r3-mono);color:#858f81;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.psm-btn.ghost{flex:none;background:transparent}
@media(max-width:1180px){
  .psampler{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"head root" "wave wave" "edit edit" "act act";gap:14px 24px}
}
@media(max-width:920px){
  .pad-sample{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;grid-template-areas:"slot act" "wave wave" "edit edit" "meta meta"}
  .ps-slot{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #171d17}
  .ps-actions{flex-direction:row;border-left:0;border-bottom:1px solid #171d17}
  .ps-wave{margin:8px}
  .ps-meta{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid #171d17}
  .ps-edit{flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:0}
  .psm-edit{flex-wrap:wrap}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .psampler{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"head" "wave" "edit" "root" "act";padding:10px 12px}
  .ps-empty small{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:620px){.white-key.is-root::after{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;padding:0;border-radius:50%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ps-btn,.psm-btn,.ps-empty,.psm-root{transition:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:none" aria-hidden="true">
<defs>
<symbol id="i-play" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 4.5l12 7.5-12 7.5z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-music" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18V5l11-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="17" cy="16" r="3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-studio" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 6h4l10 12h4M3 18h4l3-4M14 10l3-4h4M19 3l2 3-2 3M19 15l2 3-2 3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-loop" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-layers" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3l8 4.5v9L12 21l-8-4.5v-9z"/><path d="M12 12l8-4.5M12 12v9M12 12L4 7.5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-users" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.2"/><path d="M3 20c0-3.3 2.7-5.5 6-5.5s6 2.2 6 5.5"/><circle cx="17.5" cy="9" r="2.4"/><path d="M16.5 14.6c2.6.2 4.5 2.1 4.5 5.4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-mixer" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3v18M12 3v18M18 3v18"/><path d="M4 8h4M10 15h4M16 10h4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-plug" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 3v5M15 3v5M6.5 8h11v3.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1-11 0zM12 17v4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-gear" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2.5v3M12 18.5v3M2.5 12h3M18.5 12h3M5.3 5.3l2.1 2.1M16.6 16.6l2.1 2.1M5.3 18.7l2.1-2.1M16.6 7.4l2.1-2.1"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6.5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-signout" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 4H5v16h5M15 8l4 4-4 4M19 12H9"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-save" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 3h11l3 3v15H5z"/><path d="M8 3v5h7V3M8 21v-7h8v7"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-folder" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 6h6l2 2h10v11H3z"/><path d="M9 14l2 2 4-4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-upload" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 16V4M7 9l5-5 5 5M4 20h16"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-export" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 4h6v6M20 4l-9 9M18 14v6H4V6h6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-user" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="1.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/><path d="M7 18c.8-2.4 2.7-3.6 5-3.6s4.2 1.2 5 3.6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-clock" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 7.5V12l3 2"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-palette" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18c1.4 0 2-.9 2-1.8 0-1.1-1-1.4-1-2.5 0-.9.8-1.6 1.8-1.6H17a4 4 0 0 0 4-4C21 6.6 17 3 12 3z"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="11" r="1"/><circle cx="10" cy="7" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="7.5" r="1"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-chev-d" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-chev-r" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-close" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-activity" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M2 12h4l3-8 5 16 3-8h5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-note" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 17V3.5l7 2.5"/><circle cx="7" cy="17.5" r="3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-repeat" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 2l3 3-3 3M4 11V9a4 4 0 0 1 4-4h12M7 22l-3-3 3-3M20 13v2a4 4 0 0 1-4 4H4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-mic" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3"/><path d="M5.5 11a6.5 6.5 0 0 0 13 0M12 17.5V21M9 21h6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-sliders" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h9M17 6h3M4 12h3M11 12h9M4 18h11M19 18h1"/><path d="M15 4v4M9 10v4M17 16v4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-bars" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 20V9M10 20V4M14 20v-7M18 20V7"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-wave" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M2 12c1.5-5 3-5 4.5 0s3 5 4.5 0 3-5 4.5 0 3 5 4.5 0 1.5-2 2-2"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-target" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.2"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-plus" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-scope" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 7l5 5-5 5-5-5zM2 12h5M17 12h5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-spectro" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 4h6M5 8h10M5 12h14M5 16h9M5 20h12"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-terrain" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M2.5 19.5L9 8l4 6 2.5-3.5 6 9z"/><path d="M9 8l1.5 5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-galaxy" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-dna" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 3c0 6 10 12 10 18M17 3c0 6-10 12-10 18M8.5 7h7M8.5 17h7M10 12h4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-flame" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3c.7 3.6 5 5.6 5 11a5 5 0 0 1-10 0c0-2.6 1.6-3.8 2-6 1 1 1.8 2.1 2 3.4.6-2.8 1.3-5.3 1-8.4z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-matrix" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="3" width="12" height="18" rx="1"/><path d="M12 7v10"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-keyboard" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="2.5" y="6" width="19" height="12" rx="1.5"/><path d="M6 10h1M9.5 10h1M13 10h1M16.5 10h1M7 14h10"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-express" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="3" width="12" height="18" rx="1"/><path d="M9 7h6M9 11h6M9 15h3"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-grid" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4h7v7H4zM13 4h7v7h-7zM4 13h7v7H4zM13 13h7v7h-7z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-expand" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 9V4h5M20 9V4h-5M4 15v5h5M20 15v5h-5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-disc" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.2"/><path d="M12 3.5a8.5 8.5 0 0 1 8.5 8.5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-diamond" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3l9 9-9 9-9-9z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-bolt" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 2L4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7z"/></symbol>
</defs>
</svg>
<nav class="nav" aria-label="Primary navigation">
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-play"/></svg>PRICING</button>
  <button class="tab on" type="button" aria-current="page"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-music"/></svg>INSTRUMENT</button>
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-studio"/></svg>STUDIO</button>
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-loop"/></svg>LOOP</button>
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-layers"/></svg>MULTITRACK</button>
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-users"/></svg>COLLAB</button>
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-mixer"/></svg>MIXER</button>
  <button class="tab" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-plug"/></svg>VST</button>
  <div class="nav-spacer"></div>
  <span class="badge pro">PRO_ARTIST</span>
  <span class="badge sunset" id="presetBadge"><i></i><span>SUNSET</span></span>
  <button class="ibtn sq" type="button" aria-label="Settings" id="settingsBtn" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-gear"/></svg></button>
  <button class="nbtn" type="button" id="signOutBtn"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-signout"/></svg>SIGN OUT</button>
  <div class="popover" id="settingsMenu" role="menu" hidden>
    <div class="pop-title">DISPLAY</div>
    <button class="pop-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" data-setting="ticker" aria-checked="true"><i class="led"></i>Show ticker</button>
    <button class="pop-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" data-setting="glitch" aria-checked="true"><i class="led"></i>Ticker glitch effect</button>
    <button class="pop-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" data-setting="railOpen" aria-checked="true"><i class="led"></i>Show controls rail</button>
    <div class="pop-title">SESSION</div>
    <button class="pop-item danger" type="button" role="menuitem" id="resetSession">Reset session to defaults</button>
  </div>
</nav>

<header class="head">
  <div class="brand">
    <div class="logo">R3<em>/</em>NATIVE</div>
    <div class="sub">INSTRUMENT · VIRTUAL VSTS</div>
  </div>
  <div class="live" aria-live="polite"><span class="on"><i></i>LIVE</span><span>ERNESTO · R3VIBE</span><span class="midi" id="midiStatus">MIDI · CHECKING</span></div>
  <div class="bpmwrap">
    <div class="bpmlbl" id="bpmLabel">BPM</div>
    <div class="bpmval" id="bpmDisplay" role="spinbutton" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="bpmLabel" aria-valuemin="40" aria-valuemax="240" aria-valuenow="126" title="Drag, scroll, arrow keys or type a number">126</div>
    <button class="tap" id="tapBtn" type="button" aria-label="Tap tempo">TAP</button>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline" id="waveform" role="img" aria-label="Four-bar output timeline">
    <canvas id="timelineCanvas"></canvas>
    <div class="bar-nums" aria-hidden="true"><span>1</span><span>2</span><span>3</span><span>4</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="header-actions">
    <span class="user-chip"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-user"/></svg>DAM</span>
    <div class="hbtns">
      <button class="hbtn" type="button" id="saveBtn" aria-label="Save session"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-save"/></svg>SAVE</button>
      <button class="hbtn" type="button" id="sessionsBtn" aria-label="Session info"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-folder"/></svg>SESSIONS</button>
      <button class="hbtn" type="button" id="loadBtn" aria-label="Load session file"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-upload"/></svg>LOAD</button>
      <button class="hbtn icon" type="button" id="exportBtn" aria-label="Export session file" title="Export session file"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-export"/></svg></button>
    </div>
    <input type="file" id="loadInput" accept="application/json,.json" hidden>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="trans">
  <div class="studio-id"><span class="sid-ic"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-music"/></svg></span><div><b>R3</b><small>STUDIO · DAM</small></div></div>
  <div class="tgroup">
    <button class="tbtn" type="button" id="clickBtn" aria-pressed="false" title="Metronome click while the sequencer plays"><i class="led"></i><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-clock"/></svg>CLICK</button>
    <div class="tpill"><span class="tval" id="transportBpm">126</span><span class="tlbl">BPM</span></div>
    <div class="scrub">
      <div class="strk" id="scrubber" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Bar position" aria-valuemin="1" aria-valuemax="16" aria-valuenow="1" aria-valuetext="Step 1 of 16"><div class="sfil"></div><div class="sth"></div></div>
      <span class="tms" id="barTime">0 ms</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="preset">
    <button class="dd preset-btn" id="presetBtn" type="button" aria-label="Next preset"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-palette"/></svg><span id="presetName">SUNSET</span></button>
    <button class="dd preset-menu-btn" id="presetMenuBtn" type="button" aria-label="Choose preset" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-chev-d"/></svg></button>
    <div class="popover" id="presetMenu" role="listbox" aria-label="Presets" hidden></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="marquee" id="ticker" aria-label="Feature ticker">
  <div class="ticker-view" aria-hidden="true"><div class="ticker-track" id="tickerTrack"></div></div>
  <span class="sr-only">Time-first, MIDI support, accessible, multitrack DAW, VST system, IndexedDB, mobile-friendly, R3 Native, designed by Ernesto, polyphonic, Web Audio API.</span>
  <button class="ticker-x" id="tickerClose" type="button" aria-label="Hide ticker"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button>
</div>

<main class="main" id="main">
<section class="left" aria-label="Instrument controls">

  <div class="krow" role="group" aria-label="Engine and mix">
    <div class="ktile stat"><span class="klbl">UI LOAD</span><b id="cpuVal" role="meter" aria-label="Interface frame load" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0" title="Main-thread frame load">0%</b></div>
    <div class="ktile stat"><span class="klbl">VOICES</span><b id="voiceVal" role="meter" aria-label="Active voices" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="128" aria-valuenow="0">0</b></div>
    <div class="ktile fader-tile"><span class="klbl">VOL</span><div class="fader" data-knob="vol" data-min="0" data-max="100" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Master volume"></div><span class="kval"></span></div>
    <div class="ktile fader-tile"><span class="klbl">FILT</span><div class="fader" data-knob="filt" data-min="0" data-max="100" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Filter cutoff"></div><span class="kval"></span></div>
    <div class="ktile fader-tile"><span class="klbl">REV</span><div class="fader" data-knob="rev" data-min="0" data-max="100" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Reverb send"></div><span class="kval"></span></div>
    <div class="ktile fader-tile"><span class="klbl">SAT</span><div class="fader" data-knob="sat" data-min="0" data-max="100" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Saturation drive"></div><span class="kval"></span></div>
    <div class="ktile fader-tile"><span class="klbl">PCH</span><div class="fader" data-knob="pch" data-min="0" data-max="100" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Drum kit pitch"></div><span class="kval"></span></div>
    <div class="ktile qual" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Saturation character"><span class="klbl">QUALITY</span><button class="qbtn" type="button" role="radio" data-sat="soft" aria-checked="false">SOFT</button><button class="qbtn" type="button" role="radio" data-sat="hard" aria-checked="true">HARD</button></div>
    <div class="chips">
      <button class="engine-chip idle" type="button" id="dspChip"><i></i><strong>DSP</strong> <span>START AUDIO</span></button>
      <span class="engine-chip idle" id="rateChip"><i></i><strong>—</strong> AUDIO</span>
      <span class="engine-chip idle" id="persistenceStatus"><i></i><strong>STATE</strong> <span class="state-label">…</span></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PIANO KEYS -->
  <section class="box piano-box" id="pianoComponent" aria-label="Piano keys">
    <div class="bhead xl">
      <div class="btitle"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-music"/></svg>PIANO KEYS</div>
      <div class="panel-tools">
        <span class="panel-meta" id="pianoMidiMeta">● MIDI READY</span>
        <button class="expand-btn" id="pianoExpand" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="pianoComponent"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-expand"/></svg><span id="expandText">EXPAND</span></button>
        <button class="chev-btn" id="pianoCollapse" type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="pianoBody" aria-label="Collapse piano keys"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-chev-d"/></svg></button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bbody piano-body" id="pianoBody">
      <div class="piano-rows">
        <div class="ctl-grid">
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblVel">Velocity</span><b class="sval"></b></div><div class="strack" data-slider="velocity" data-min="1" data-max="127" data-step="1" data-default="102" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="lblVel"><div class="sfill"></div><div class="sthumb"></div></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span>Octave</span><b id="octaveValue">0</b></div><div class="stepper"><button class="obtn" type="button" data-oct="-1" aria-label="Octave down">−</button><span class="odisp" id="octaveDisplay" aria-live="polite">0</span><button class="obtn" type="button" data-oct="1" aria-label="Octave up">+</button></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblBend">Pitch Bend</span><b class="sval"></b></div><div class="strack" data-slider="bend" data-min="-12" data-max="12" data-step="0.1" data-default="0" data-spring="true" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="lblBend"><div class="sfill"></div><div class="sthumb"></div></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblMod">Modulation</span><b class="sval"></b></div><div class="strack" data-slider="mod" data-min="0" data-max="100" data-step="1" data-default="0" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="lblMod"><div class="sfill"></div><div class="sthumb"></div></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblTr">Transpose</span><b class="sval"></b></div><div class="strack" data-slider="transpose" data-min="-24" data-max="24" data-step="1" data-default="0" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="lblTr"><div class="sfill"></div><div class="sthumb"></div></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><label for="curveSelect">Velocity Curve</label><button class="link-btn" type="button" id="curveToggle" aria-controls="curvePanel" aria-expanded="true">GRAPH</button></div>
            <div class="select-wrap"><select class="dd" id="curveSelect"><option value="linear">Linear</option><option value="soft">Soft</option><option value="hard">Hard</option><option value="exponential">Exponential</option><option value="logarithmic">Logarithmic</option><option value="scurve">S-Curve</option><option value="fixed">Fixed</option><option value="custom">Custom</option></select><span class="select-chev" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-chev-d"/></svg></span></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblTune">Global Tune</span><b class="sval"></b></div><div class="strack" data-slider="tune" data-min="-100" data-max="100" data-step="1" data-default="0" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="lblTune"><div class="sfill"></div><div class="sthumb"></div></div></div>
          <div class="ctl"><div class="ctl-h"><span>Sustain Pedal</span></div><button class="swt" id="sustainBtn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">OFF</button></div>
        </div>

        <div class="curve" id="curvePanel">
          <div class="chd"><span class="ctit" id="curveTitle">VELOCITY CURVE · LINEAR</span><button class="cx" id="curveClose" type="button" aria-label="Hide velocity curve"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button></div>
          <div class="curve-body">
            <div class="graph" id="curveGraph">
              <div class="yaxis" aria-hidden="true"><span>127</span><span>96</span><span>64</span><span>32</span><span>0</span></div>
              <div class="plot">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 400 160" preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img" aria-labelledby="curveTitle">
                  <line id="curveIn" x1="-10" y1="160" x2="-10" y2="0" stroke="#b0d828" stroke-width="1.2" opacity=".7" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
                  <polyline id="curveGlow" points="" fill="none" stroke="#b0d828" stroke-width="5" opacity=".12" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
                  <polyline id="curveLine" points="" fill="none" stroke="#b0d828" stroke-width="1.6" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
                </svg>
                <span class="cp end0" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="cp end1" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <span class="cp mid" id="curveMid" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-label="Curve shape (drag to customise)" aria-valuemin="1" aria-valuemax="126"></span>
                <span class="cp hit" id="curveHit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="xaxis" aria-hidden="true"><span>0</span><span>32</span><span>64</span><span>96</span><span>127</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="curve-side">
              <div class="vel-keys"><div class="pmini" id="miniPiano" aria-hidden="true"></div><span class="side-lbl">VELOCITY</span>
                <div class="velmeter"><span>IN</span><div class="vm"><i id="velIn"></i></div><b id="velInVal">—</b></div>
                <div class="velmeter"><span>OUT</span><div class="vm"><i id="velOut"></i></div><b id="velOutVal">—</b></div>
              </div>
              <dl class="cinfo">
                <dt>TYPE</dt><dd id="ciType">Linear</dd>
                <dt>RESPONSE</dt><dd id="ciResp">Direct</dd>
                <dt>SENSITIVITY</dt><dd id="ciSens">100%</dd>
                <dt>OUTPUT</dt><dd id="ciOut">0 – 127</dd>
                <dt class="sr-only">LAST</dt><dd class="sr-only" id="ciLast">—</dd>
              </dl>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="hint">
          <span><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-keyboard"/></svg>KEYBOARD: <kbd>Z-M</kbd> (<span id="hintLow">C4–B4</span>), <kbd>Q-U</kbd> (<span id="hintHigh">C5–B5</span>) · SHARPS <kbd>S D G H J</kbd> / <kbd>2 3 5 6 7</kbd> · ↑↓ <kbd>SHIFT</kbd> OCTAVES</span>
          <span><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-express"/></svg>EXPRESSION: 8 VELOCITY CURVES · PITCH BEND · MODULATION · TRANSPOSE</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="psampler" id="pianoSampler" role="group" aria-label="Piano sampler">
        <div class="psm-head">
          <div class="ctl-h"><span>Sampler</span><b id="psmState">Synth</b></div>
          <div class="psm-file" id="psmFile">No sample loaded. The built-in piano voice is playing.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ps-wave" id="psmWave" title="Click to load a sample"><canvas aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
          <div class="ps-empty"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-upload"/></svg><div><b>DROP A SAMPLE TO PLAY IT ACROSS THE KEYS</b><small>WAV · MP3 · OGG · FLAC · UP TO 60 S · ROOT NOTE READ FROM FILE NAME</small></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="psm-root">
          <div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblRoot">Root Note</span><b id="psmHz">261.6 Hz</b></div>
          <div class="stepper" role="group" aria-labelledby="lblRoot"><button class="obtn" type="button" id="psmRootDn" aria-label="Root note down" aria-disabled="true">−</button><span class="odisp" id="psmRoot" aria-live="polite">C4</span><button class="obtn" type="button" id="psmRootUp" aria-label="Root note up" aria-disabled="true">+</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="psm-actions">
          <button class="psm-btn primary" id="psmLoad" type="button"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-upload"/></svg><span>LOAD SAMPLE</span></button>
          <button class="psm-btn" id="psmClear" type="button" disabled>CLEAR</button>
        </div>
        <div class="psm-edit" role="group" aria-label="Piano sample edits">
          <button class="psm-tog" id="psmRev" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><i></i>Reverse</button>
          <button class="psm-tog loop" id="psmLoop" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><i></i>Loop</button>
          <div class="ctl psm-gain"><div class="ctl-h"><span id="lblPsmGain">Gain</span><b class="sval"></b></div><div class="strack" data-psm="gain" data-min="-24" data-max="12" data-step="0.5" data-default="0" role="slider" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="lblPsmGain"><div class="sfill"></div><div class="sthumb"></div></div></div>
          <span class="psm-region" id="psmRegion">Region —</span>
          <button class="psm-btn ghost" id="psmReset" type="button">Reset edits</button>
        </div>
        <input type="file" id="psmInput" accept="audio/*,.wav,.mp3,.ogg,.oga,.flac,.aif,.aiff,.m4a,.aac,.opus" hidden>
        <div class="ps-drop" aria-hidden="true"><span>RELEASE TO LOAD INTO <b>PIANO</b></span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="piano-shell">
